item.text:
Continuation completed across all eight chapters. No scores were assigned.

The workspace was read-only, so I could not write `research-ledger-manifest.json`. The following new provisional units should be appended with unchanged `methodology_ids`:

- `WEB-1B-013` — Pentagon’s 2023 China report assessed that China was increasing nuclear-force readiness and moving toward a launch-on-warning posture; this directly addresses the operational gap, while remaining an external assessment rather than verified Chinese doctrine. Lenses: `1B.3`, `1B.7`, `1B.10`. [DoD release](https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/Release/Article/3561549/dod-releases-2023-report-on-military-and-security-developments-involving-the-pe/); corroborating technical discussion [here](https://doi.org/10.1080/00963402.2023.2295206).

- `WEB-2B-010` — The UN Secretary-General welcomed the China-facilitated Saudi-Iran agreement and its two-month timetable for restored relations, independently confirming a concrete diplomatic outcome. Lenses: `2B.1`, `2B.7`, `2B.10`. [UN note](https://www.un.org/sg/en/content/sg/notes-correspondents/2023-03-10/note-correspondents-the-announcement-iran-and-saudi-arabia-will-resume-ties).

- `WEB-2B-011` — U.S. officials said Saudi Arabia’s pre-existing interest in ending Yemen-related tensions helped drive the agreement, limiting attribution of the outcome exclusively to Xi or China. Lenses: `2B.1`, `2B.7`, `2B.10`. [Axios report](https://www.axios.com/2023/03/15/saudi-relations-biden-better-iran-china-deal).

- `WEB-3B-013` — China’s procuratorates reported that more than 99.75% of public complaints received replies within seven days and 97.25% were addressed within three months in 2023. This is official process evidence, not independent proof of effective remedy. Lenses: `3B.4`, `3B.9`, `3B.10`. [Supreme People’s Procuratorate](https://en.spp.gov.cn/2024-02/22/c_965112.htm).

- `WEB-4B-013` — Chinese courts reported accountability for more than 2,500 personnel who violated rules against improper interference in judicial cases, including 723 cases found through retrospective review. This supports formal corrective machinery while leaving practical judicial autonomy unresolved. Lenses: `4B.4`, `4B.5`, `4B.10`. [Supreme People’s Court](https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/425882.html).

- `WEB-5B-012` — IMF briefing identified property-sector contraction and local-government debt reduction as central unresolved policy problems, confirming that 2023 recovery did not remove the main structural constraints. Lenses: `5B.3`, `5B.9`, `5B.10`. [IMF briefing](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/02/05/tr020224-transcript-of-press-briefing-on-2023-china-article-iv-staff-report).

- `WEB-6B-011` — China’s Ministry of Education reported 2023 senior-secondary enrollment of 91.8%, increased preschool teachers, and 1,736 additional high-quality compulsory-education schools. These are implementation outputs, not independent evidence of learning quality. Lenses: `6B.2`, `6B.4`, `6B.9`, `6B.10`. [MOE release](https://en.moe.gov.cn/news/press_releases/202403/t20240311_1119782.html).

- `WEB-6B-012` — Official figures reported 6.46 trillion yuan in 2023 education expenditure, with preschool, compulsory, and senior-secondary spending increasing year over year. Lenses: `6B.1`, `6B.2`, `6B.9`. [Gov.cn report](https://english.www.gov.cn/archive/statistics/202407/23/content_WS669ee6e0c6d0868f4e8e95a8.html).

- `WEB-7B-014` — A fact-check found no reliable evidence supporting a fabricated quotation attributing an execution threat to Xi. This is useful contrary evidence against accepting viral allegations, but does not establish positive personal integrity. Lenses: `7B.1`, `7B.2`, `7B.10`. [Cofact fact-check](https://blog.cofact.org/en/factcheck681223/).

- `WEB-8B-016` — Xi’s economic-work messaging emphasized expanding domestic demand, restoring confidence, and coordinating consumption and investment, providing a more specific 2023 implementation objective than the general modernization program. Lenses: `8B.1`, `8B.2`, `8B.6`. [Gov.cn](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202302/16/content_WS63ede123c6d0a757729e6d2a.html).

- `WEB-8B-017` — Academic analysis of China’s 2023 local-debt bailout found that property-market weakness and falling land revenues severely strained local finances and that the response left substantial risks unresolved. Lenses: `8B.7`, `8B.8`, `8B.9`, `8B.10`. [China Journal](https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/doi/full/10.1086/733767).

The main recoverable gaps were therefore attempted. Remaining shortfalls are genuine: independent nuclear command verification, personal asset or enrichment evidence for Xi, independent remedy outcomes, and longitudinal durability audits remain unavailable or insufficient.
